blocks.text: Yeh chapter 25 (Ecology) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har sawal 4 number ka hai (wazahat, farq, structure ki tafseel, misalein), aik 4 number ka hissa ya 1+3 / 2+2 ke chhote hisson mein. Har sawal ka poora model jawab hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Describe the levels of ecological organization from species to biosphere, with one example of each from Pakistan. (4 marks)
(Species se biosphere tak ecological organization ki satahen Pakistan ki aik aik misaal ke saath bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Fitrat barhti pecheedgi ki satahon mein munazzam hai:

1. Species: darja bandi ki bunyadi ikai; milti julti jismani aur genetic khususiyaat wale jandar jo aapas mein fertile aulad paida kar sakein. Misaal: Indus River Dolphin.
2. Population: aik species ke afraad jo aik ilaqe mein aik waqt par rahen. Misaal: Chitral Gol National Park ke Markhor.
3. Community: aik ilaqe mein rehne aur amal karne wali tamam species ki populations. Misaal: Karachi ka mangrove forest (mangrove darakht, mudskipper, kekray, sahili parinde).
4. Ecosystem: biotic hisse aur abiotic hisse (dhoop, mitti, paani, hawa); energy aik taraf behti, nutrients cycle karte hain. Misaal: Thar Desert.
5. Biome: khaas aab-o-hawa, mitti, bulandi aur mutabiq paudon-janwaron wala bara geographic ilaqa. Misaal: Murree aur Swat ka Coniferous Forest Biome.
6. Biosphere: sab se oonchi aur jame satah, tamam biomes ka majmua; zameen ka har woh hissa jahan zindagi hai, Arabian Sea ki gehraiyon se Himalaya ki chotiyon tak.

book_ref.quote: It refers to “a group of organisms that share similar physical and genetic characteristics

blocks.prompt:
2 Explain with examples how (i) a population differs from a species, and (ii) an ecosystem differs from a community. (4 marks)
(Misaalon ke saath wazeh karein ke (i) population species se kaise mukhtalif hai, aur (ii) ecosystem community se kaise mukhtalif hai.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Population aur species:
1. Species duniya bhar mein jandaron ki aik 'qisam' hai; is ke members aapas mein fertile aulad paida kar sakte hain.
2. Population aik species ka khaas group hai jo aik ilaqe mein aik waqt par rehta hai.
3. Misaal: poore Pakistan ke Markhor species hain; Chitral Gol National Park ke Markhor aik population hain.

(ii) Ecosystem aur community:
1. Community aik ilaqe mein rehne aur amal karne wali tamam species (paude, janwar, fungi, bacteria) ki populations hai.
2. Ecosystem community (biotic hisse) aur abiotic hisse (dhoop, mitti, paani, hawa) dono hai.
3. Misaal: Thar mein saanp, blackbuck aur jhaariyan community hain; ecosystem mein sakht garmi, sarakte teele aur kam barish bhi shamil hain.

book_ref.quote: If we consider Markhors across all of Pakistan, we are referring to the species

blocks.prompt:
3 What is a primary reservoir? Classify biogeochemical cycles on the basis of their primary reservoirs. (4 marks)
(Primary reservoir kya hai? Biogeochemical cycles ko un ke primary reservoir ki bunyad par taqseem karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Biogeochemical cycles kimiyai anasir (carbon, nitrogen, oxygen, phosphorus) ki ecosystem ke biotic aur abiotic hisson ke darmiyan chakkar dar harkat hain.

Primary reservoir ('sink' ya 'pool') biosphere ka bara hissa hai jahan cycle ka element lambe arse tak jama rehta hai.

Is bunyad par cycles do qisam ke hain:

book_ref.quote: where the element of a biogeochemical cycle is stored for long periods of time

rows: Reservoir hawa ya samandar (evaporation ke zariye).
Nitrogen, oxygen, carbon aur water cycles.

blocks.prompt:
4 Describe the abiotic loop of the water cycle. (4 marks)
(Water cycle ka abiotic loop bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Abiotic loop hawa, zameen aur samandar mein paani ki harkat hai:

1. Evaporation: suraj poora cycle chalata hai. Suraj ki shuaen samandar aur jheelon ka paani garam karti hain aur paani bhaap banta hai. Aalmi evaporation ka 86% samandaron se; Pakistan ke liye Arabian Sea bhaap ka bara zariya hai.
2. Condensation: oopar jati bhaap thandi ho kar qatre ya barf ke zarre banti hai jo gard ke zarron se chimat kar badal banate hain.
3. Precipitation: bhari qatre gravity se barish, barf ya sleet (barf ya olon mili barish) ki shakal mein girte hain.
4. Infiltration aur runoff: zameen par paani do raaste leta hai. Infiltration mein mitti mein rista (percolation), water table tak ja kar groundwater banta hai. Surface runoff zameen par khula behao hai jab paani mazeed jazb na ho; yeh nadi naalon, daryaon aur samandar mein jata hai. Pakistan mein runoff Indus ko aur infiltration aquifers ko bharta hai.

book_ref.quote: Once water hits the land, it takes one of two main paths to complete the cycle

blocks.prompt:
5 Describe the biotic loop of the water cycle: how water enters and leaves organisms. (4 marks)
(Water cycle ka biotic loop bayan karein: paani jandaron mein kaise aata aur un se kaise nikalta hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Biotic hisse mein paani ka dakhla (aik taraf, abiotic mahol se):
1. Zameeni paude root hairs se mitti ka paani jazb kar ke photosynthesis aur sahare (turgor pressure) ke liye istemal karte hain.
2. Janwar meetha paani pee kar aur khurak kha kar paani lete hain.

Paani ki abiotic mahol mein wapsi:
1. Transpiration: sab se bara rasta; paude patton ke stomata se bhaap chhorte hain.
2. Respiration: paude aur janwar zimni taur par paani banate hain; yeh 'metabolic water' bhaap ban kar nikalta hai.
3. Excretion aur egestion: peshab aur fuzla ke zariye paani mitti ya paani mein wapas.
4. Perspiration (paseena): jild ke masamon se paani nikal kar ur jata hai.
5. Murda jismon ka decomposition bhi paani mitti ya hawa mein wapas karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Once water has served its purpose inside an organism

blocks.prompt:
6 What is nitrogen fixation? Describe its three ways. (4 marks)
(Nitrogen fixation kya hai? Is ke teen tareeqe bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Atmosphere 78% nitrogen gas (N₂) hai jis ke atoms mazboot triple bond se jure hain jise paude nahi tor sakte. Nitrogen fixation N₂ ko ammonia (NH₃) jaise inorganic compounds mein badalne ka amal hai. Yeh nitrogen ka mitti mein dakhla hai aur teen tareeqon se hota hai:

1. Biological fixation: mitti ke microorganisms hawa ki nitrogen fix kar ke ammonia banate hain. Do qismen: (a) azad (non-symbiotic) jaise cyanobacteria (blue-green algae), Azotobacter, Clostridium; (b) mutualistic (symbiotic) jaise Rhizobium jo Chana aur Moong jaisi legumes ki root nodules mein hota hai.
2. Atmospheric fixation: barish aur toofan mein bijli nitrogen ko oxygen se milati hai; N₂ nitrogen oxides aur phir nitrates banti hai. Sirf 5-10% is tarah fix hoti hai.
3. Industrial fixation: nitrogen wali khaad ki tayyari jis mein nitrogen aur hydrogen mila kar ammonia banti hai.

book_ref.quote: It is done in three ways;

blocks.prompt:
7 Describe nitrification and assimilation as steps of the nitrogen cycle. (4 marks)
(Nitrogen cycle ke qadam nitrification aur assimilation bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Nitrification (paudon ki khurak banana):
1. Ammonia aksar zehreeli ya zyada miqdar mein paudon ke liye mushkil hai.
2. Mitti ke bacteria converter ka kaam karte hain: Nitrosomonas ammonia ko nitrite (NO₂⁻) banata hai.
3. Nitrobacter nitrite ko nitrate (NO₃⁻) banata hai.
4. Nitrates paude aasani se jazb karte hain.

(ii) Assimilation (zinda duniya mein dakhla):
1. Paude aur microbes mitti se nitrates jazb karte hain.
2. In se proteins, DNA aur chlorophyll banate hain.
3. Janwar paude aur doosre janwar kha kar nitrogen lete hain.

book_ref.quote: Soil bacteria (such as Nitrosomonas and Nitrobacter) act as converters

blocks.prompt:
8 What are trophic levels? Describe the trophic levels of an ecosystem with examples. (4 marks)
(Trophic levels kya hain? Ecosystem ke trophic levels misaalon ke saath bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Ecosystem mein jandar khurak ke mukhtalif groups mein tarteeb diye jate hain jinhein trophic levels kehte hain:

1. Trophic level 1: sabz paude, algae, photosynthetic bacteria; primary producers.
2. Trophic level 2: primary consumers (herbivores) jo seedha producers khate hain, maslan keeray, khargosh.
3. Trophic level 3: secondary consumers (carnivores) aur herbivores par palne wale parasites, maslan mendak, saanp.
4. Trophic level 4: tertiary consumers (carnivores khane wale), maslan bheriya, baaz.
5. Decomposers aur detritivores (kekray, girdh, geedar) alag trophic level hain. Yeh tamam levels se khurak lete hain, detritus (murda gal-sar raha maadda) aur fuzla khate hain.

book_ref.quote: They feed on all trophic levels

blocks.prompt:
9 In a grassland, producers fix 45,000 kcal of energy by photosynthesis. Using the rule that only about 10% of energy passes to the next trophic level, find the energy gained by primary, secondary and tertiary consumers. What percentage of the original energy reaches the tertiary consumers? (4 marks)
(Aik ghaas ke maidan mein producers photosynthesis se 45,000 kcal energy fix karte hain. Is usool se ke sirf taqreeban 10% energy agle trophic level tak jati hai, primary, secondary aur tertiary consumers ki energy maloom karein. Asal energy ka kitna feesad tertiary consumers tak pahunchta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har trophic level se agle tak 10% (0.1) se zarb dein.

book_ref.quote: During the flow of energy to the next trophic levels, only about 10% is transferred to the next trophic level

blocks.final_answer: Primary 4,500 kcal; secondary 450 kcal; tertiary 45 kcal, jo producers ki energy ka sirf 0.1% hai. Har level par energy zaya hoti hai, is liye chhoti food chains zyada efficient hain.

blocks.prompt:
10 Explain why very little usable energy remains in an ecosystem at its higher trophic levels, and why short food chains are more energy efficient. (4 marks)
(Wazeh karein ke ecosystem ke oonche trophic levels par bohat kam qabil-e-istemal energy kyun bachti hai, aur chhoti food chains zyada efficient kyun hain.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Energy ka behao maadde ki cycling ke bar-aks aik taraf hai; woh wapas mamba tak nahi jati.
2. Producers par girne wali suraj ki energy ka sirf 1 se 2% organic maadde ki bond energy banta hai.
3. Aik level ki energy ka sirf taqreeban 10% agle level tak jata hai; har level par energy (hararat ban kar) zaya hoti hai.
4. Misaal: producers 10,000 kcal fix karein to primary ko 1,000, secondary ko 100 aur tertiary ko 10 kcal milti hai.
5. Is liye mukhtalif levels par istemal ke baad bohat kam qabil-e-istemal energy bachti hai, aur aam taur par sirf teen ya chaar trophic levels hote hain.
6. Chhoti food chains mein kam levels (kam qadam) hain jahan hararat zaya ho, is liye in ki efficiency lambi chains se zyada hai.

book_ref.quote: About 1 to 2% of the solar energy that falls on a first trophic level

blocks.prompt:
11 What is population survivorship? Describe the three types of survivorship curves with examples. (4 marks)
(Population survivorship kya hai? Teen qisam ki survivorship curves misaalon ke saath bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Population survivorship kisi group ke un members ka feesad hai jo aik khaas umar par zinda hon. Ise survivorship curves se dikhate hain jin mein Y-axis zinda afraad ki tadaad aur X-axis umar hai. Teen qismen:

1. Type I (convex): afraad burhape tak jeete phir tezi se marte hain. Mahol ka maut par asar bohat kam; aksar poori umar jeete hain. Misaal: insan aur mammals.
2. Type II (diagonal): poori zindagi maut ka imkan barabar. Mahol ka maut par ahem asar aur bachon par boorhon se zyada sakht nahi. Misaal: parinde, chhipkaliyan, rodents.
3. Type III (concave): bachpan mein bohat zyada amwat, magar jawani tak pahunchne walon ki sharah-e-amwat bohat kam. Misaal: machhliyan aur bohat se invertebrates.

book_ref.quote: Such graphs make three kinds of survivorship curves

blocks.prompt:
12 Define population growth. Explain the exponential and logistic growth models and relate the logistic model to carrying capacity. (4 marks)
(Population growth ki tareef karein. Exponential aur logistic growth models wazeh karein aur logistic model ko carrying capacity se jorein.)
blocks.explanation:
Population growth kisi khaas arse mein afraad ki tadaad mein izafa hai; yeh population ki ahem khususiyat hai.

1. Exponential model: population bila had apni intihai raftaar se barhti hai. Har nasl mein muqarrar tadaad nahi jorti balke har waqt ki ikai mein usi nisbat se barhti hai. Har population yeh nahi dikhati.
2. Logistic model: barhti population jagah, roshni, paani ya nutrients ki kami se aakhir had tak pahunchti hai. Yeh carrying capacity par tham jati hai aur curve sigmoid (chapti S) hoti hai.

Carrying capacity kisi species ke afraad ki woh zyada se zyada tadaad hai jise mahol lambe arse tak payedar taur par sahara de sake. Yeh limiting factors (khurak, paani, panah, ghonslon ki jagah, shikari, bimariyan) se tay hoti hai; yahi logistic growth ko rokte hain.

book_ref.quote: There are two population growth models

blocks.prompt:
13 Describe the three patterns of population dispersion with examples. (4 marks)
(Population ke phelao ke teen andaaz misaalon ke saath bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Dispersion population mein afraad ke phelne ka andaaz hai:

1. Random spacing: afraad aapas mein zyada amal nahi karte. Fitrat mein aam nahi. Misaal: hawa se bikharne wale beejon wale paude jo jahan munasib jagah giren ug jate hain.
2. Uniform spacing: afraad barabar phele hote hain. Kuch paude qareebi paudon ki barhotri rokte hain; ilaqa qaim rakhne wale janwar jaise ghonsla banate penguins bhi uniform phelao dikhate hain.
3. Clumped spacing: wasail ki na-barabar taqseem se afraad groups mein jama hote hain. Fitrat mein aam kyun ke jandar wasail wali jagah pasand karte hain. Misaal: beej seedha zameen par girane wale paude, aur groups mein rehne wale janwar.

book_ref.quote: Another key characteristic of population structure is the way in which individuals of a population are dispersed

blocks.prompt:
14 Explain (i) population density and its effects, and (ii) minimal viable population size. (4 marks)
(Wazeh karein (i) population density aur is ke asraat, aur (ii) minimal viable population size.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Population density:
1. Fi ikai raqba ya hajm afraad ki tadaad, maslan Muzaffarabad mein fi murabba kilometer shehtoot ke darakht, ya test tube mein fi milliliter E. coli.
2. Carrying capacity ke qareeb ghani population mein wasail par sakht muqabla, paidaish kam aur maut ka khatra zyada.
3. Zyada density se aloodgi bhi barh sakti hai.

(ii) Minimal viable population size:
1. Population ke bachne aur qaim rehne ke liye kam se kam zaroori tadaad.
2. Is se kam ho to nasl khatam hone ka bara khatra.
3. Bohat chhoti population (jaise Pakistan ke chand Himalayan Brown Bears) mein inbreeding se genetic kamzoriyan aur kam immunity.
4. Aik hi aafat (sailaab ya jangal ki aag) aisi population mita sakti hai.

book_ref.quote: If a population falls below this critical size, it faces a high risk of extinction

blocks.prompt:
15 Explain the natural greenhouse effect. Name the major greenhouse gases and give the sources of each. (4 marks)
(Qudrati greenhouse effect wazeh karein. Bari greenhouse gases aur un ke zaraye batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Greenhouse effect: qudrati amal jis mein atmosphere ki gases (GHGs) zameen ki satah se nikalne wali hararat qaid karti hain. Yeh dhoop andar aane deti hain magar hararat ko khala mein jane se rokti hain, is tarah zameen zindagi ke liye garam rehti hai. Insani sargarmiyon ki zyada GHGs ghair qudrati izafi garmi paida karti hain.

Bari GHGs aur zaraye:
1. Carbon dioxide (CO₂): sab se ahem; fossil fuels (koyla, tel, gas) jalane aur jangal katne se. Is ki miqdar sanati daur se pehle 280 ppm se 2026 mein 428 ppm hui.
2. Methane (CH₄): koyle aur gas ki paidawar, maweshi (gaaye mein enteric fermentation) aur zarat se.
3. Nitrous oxide (N₂O): zarai aur sanati sargarmiyan aur fossil fuels ka jalna.
4. Fluorinated gases: purane fridge aur AC jaise sanati amal se masnooi gases.

book_ref.quote: Important greenhouse gases include:

blocks.prompt:
16 Describe the effects of global warming on Pakistan through (i) heatwaves and floods, and (ii) glacial melting and sea level rise. (4 marks)
(Global warming ke Pakistan par asraat bayan karein: (i) heatwaves aur sailaab, aur (ii) glaciers ka pighalna aur samandar ki satah ka barhna.)
blocks.explanation:
Global warming insani sargarmiyon se zameen ke ausat darja hararat mein taweel muddati izafa hai jis ki bari wajah zyada GHGs hain.

(i) Heatwaves aur sailaab:
1. Jacobabad aur Sibi duniya ke garam tareen maqamat mein hain; 50°C se upar jism darja hararat qaboo nahi kar pata, jaanleva heatstroke, aur maweshi heat stress ka shikar.
2. Chhoti garam sardiyon mein keeray aur machhar zyada jeete hain; garmi khushk saali aur jangal ki aag ka khatra barhati hai.
3. Garam hawa zyada nami rakhti hai: be-qaida shadeed barish, 'turbo-charged' monsoon aur sailaab jo jangal, ghar aur zarat tabah karte, mitti ka kataao, nutrients ki kami, paani ki aloodgi aur paani se phelne wali bimariyan laate hain.

(ii) Glaciers ka pighalna aur samandar ki satah:
1. Pakistan mein polar ilaqon ke baad sab se zyada glaciers hain; Baltoro aur Batura jaise glaciers tezi se pighal kar GLOFs laate hain; 2025 mein Gilgit-Baltistan aur Chitral mein pul aur gaon tabah hue.
2. Glaciers khatam hone par Indus darya sookh sakta hai.
3. Polar barf pighalne aur garmi se paani phailne se samandar ki satah barhti hai; Thatta aur Badin mein samandari paani zarkhez zameen ko khari daldal bana raha hai.

book_ref.quote: Rising temperatures cause these glaciers (like Baltoro and Batura) to melt rapidly

blocks.prompt:
17 Explain how global warming threatens food security and ecosystems. (4 marks)
(Wazeh karein ke global warming food security aur ecosystems ke liye kaise khatra hai.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Food insecurity:
1. Gandum aur chawal ke phool aane ke waqt zyada garmi paidawar kafi kam kar deti hai.
2. Shadeed garmi mitti ki nami urati aur zarkhez zameen ko sehra banati hai (desertification).
3. Sailaab zarat tabah karte aur mitti ka kataao aur nutrients ki kami laate hain; samandari paani khet khari daldal banata hai; maweshi heat stress ka shikar.

(ii) Ecosystem disruption:
1. Darja hararat aur barish ke andaaz ki tez tabdeeli biodiversity ke liye sangeen khatra hai.
2. Species ko habitat badalne ya hijrat par majboor karti hai.
3. Is se species khatre mein aur nasl khatam tak ho jati hain.
4. Maslan alpine meadows global warming par bohat hassas hain kyun ke pighalti barf un ka nazuk tawazun bigarti hai.

book_ref.quote: Rapid shifts in temperature and rainfall patterns cause serious threats to biodiversity

blocks.prompt:
18 Compare the alpine meadows with the tropical thorn forest of Pakistan. (4 marks)
(Pakistan ke alpine meadows aur tropical thorn forest ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Pakistan ki geography, buland chotiyon se Arabian Sea tak, ecological tanawwo ki 'chhoti duniya' banati hai. Do mukhtalif ecosystems:

book_ref.quote: The following are the four most significant ecosystems of Pakistan

rows: Buland 'thande sehra' ya ghaas ke maidan; bare darakht nahi.
Maidani ilaqon ka sab se phela zameeni ecosystem; kaantedar xerophytic paude.
Gilgit-Baltistan, Chitral, Swat, AJK ki chotiyan aur Deosai.
Punjab, Sindh, Balochistan ke Indus maidan.
Khushk se neem khushk; garmiyon mein 50°C tak.
Zyada tar bhari barf (6 feet tak).
Paude: chhote junipers, birch, willow, alpine ghaas.
Janwar: snow leopard, bhoora reechh, ibex, musk deer, marmots, monal.
Janwar: oont, houbara bustard, chinkara, sunehri geedar, gerbil, sehi.
Halat: nazuk, global warming par hassas.
Halat: bastiyon aur nehri zarat se buri tarah bigra hua.

blocks.prompt:
19 Write a note on the alpine and sub-alpine meadows of Pakistan: location, abiotic profile, key flora and fauna, and status. (4 marks)
(Pakistan ke alpine aur sub-alpine meadows par note likhein: jagah, abiotic profile, aham paude aur janwar, aur halat.)
blocks.explanation:
Alpine aur sub-alpine meadows buland 'thande sehra' ya ghaas ke maidan hain jahan mausam bare darakhton ke liye bohat sakht hai.

1. Jagah: Gilgit-Baltistan, Chitral, Swat, Azad Jammu & Kashmir ki chotiyan aur Deosai Plains.
2. Abiotic profile: shadeed sardi, ausat salana darja hararat 1°C se 10°C; zyada tar bhari barf (6 feet tak).
3. Aham paude: chhote junipers, birch (Betula utilis), willow, alpine ghaas aur jangli phool.
4. Aham janwar: snow leopard, Himalayan bhoora reechh, Himalayan ibex, musk deer, marmots; parinde snowcock, monal, golden eagle.
5. Halat: nazuk; global warming par bohat hassas kyun ke pighalti barf tawazun bigarti hai.

book_ref.quote: These are high-altitude "cold deserts" or grasslands

blocks.prompt:
20 Write a note on the mangrove forests of Pakistan: location, abiotic profile, key flora and fauna, and status. (4 marks)
(Pakistan ke mangrove forests par note likhein: jagah, abiotic profile, aham paude aur janwar, aur halat.)
blocks.explanation:
Mangroves ko 'samandar ke jangal' kaha jata hai; yeh zameen aur samandar ke milap par namak bardasht jangal hain (sahili ecosystem).

1. Jagah: Sindh (Indus Delta mein Keti Bandar aur Mirpur Sakro) aur Balochistan ka sahil (Miani Hor, Kalmat Khor, Jiwani, Gawatar Bay).
2. Abiotic profile: brackish paani (darya ka meetha aur samandar ka khara mila hua); anaerobic (kam oxygen) keechar wali mitti, is liye darakhton ki saans lene wali jaren hoti hain.
3. Aham paude: Avicennia marina (Timmar) jangal ka 95%.
4. Aham janwar: magarmachh, jheenga, mudskipper, kekray, lobster, kachhwa, saanp, dolphin aur flamingo, crane, pelican.
5. Halat: Indus ka meetha paani kam hone aur Karachi ki aloodgi se khatre mein, magar bahali ke mansoobon ne madad ki hai.

book_ref.quote: these are salt-tolerant forests located at the interface of land and sea
